title: Gull Watch
meta_description: Gull Watch is a beachfront 1BR penthouse in PCB with a huge balcony, stunning views, pool, hot tub, and direct access to St. Andrew's State Park
description_expanded:
You'll enjoy the glamour \& convenience of this stylish, upscale condo right on the beach! This beautiful penthouse condo on the 13th floor has everything you need to enjoy your Panama City Beach vacation. You can't beat the views from the XL balcony where you can enjoy your morning coffee at sunrise or sip wine at sunset. Walk to St. Andrew's State Park or Patches right outside the parking lot since the location of this cozy condo and its incredible views are one you will never forget!

Welcome to Gull Watch, where you can walk straight into the ever popular St. Andrew's State Park on PCB's East End without paying the $8 vehicle fee. Take advantage of all of the amenities offered on site like seasonally heated gulf front pool or hot tub, shuffleboard, picnic tables and tennis. This resort is a local favorite with breathtaking sunset views from the balcony. Beach chair service is available to rent right in front of the property.

Guests will need to check-in at the security gate for passes and property details.
Unit is located on the 13th floor.
Elevators are on the ground level at the center of the building.

Local hosts available 24/7 who live right down the street. You'll receive detailed check in instructions the day prior to arrival and we are responsive and helpful throughout your stay.

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure views, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: St. Andrews State Park, Camp Helen State Park, Ms. Newby's and Runaway Island (karaoke), Jimmy Buffett's Margaritaville, Pier Park, Gulf World Marine Park, Water Planet, Little Village Waterfront Shopping Market, SkyWheel, Shipwreck Island Waterpark.

Home Truths:
- Please be sure to read and follow all house rules.
- Please note, only starter amenities are provided. You will need to purchase additional toilet paper, trash bags, laundry detergent, etc.
- Guests must be 25 years or older to book this home.

Parking Details:
- Two vehicles are allowed per unit, but during major Holidays only 1 vehicle is allowed.
- A parking pass is required and HOA charges a fee of $40 for each vehicle.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.

Bath: Travel-Sized Toiletries (Shower Gel, Shampoo, Conditioner, Soap)
